full_judgment: 10. We have heard the learned Advocates from both sides, perused all materials on records including the judgment of the court below and the deposition of the witnesses from both sides. The plaintiffs produced 23 exhibits which include the kabala deeds and other relevant documents while the defendants failed to produce any documents at all in support of their claims. From perusal of the judgment it transpires that regrettably the trial court did not consider some vital factors which also included the deposition of the PWs. It also transpires that in absence of any documents or any other credible evidence the trial court arrived upon a presumption based on its own conjecture and surmise that the kabala deeds might have been created as a result of "false personation". But however the trial court did not in its finding make any attempt to explain or otherwise analyse the basis of its presumption.
